paper_title: First Constraints on the Photon Coupling of Axion-like Particles from Multimessenger Studies of the Neutron Star Merger GW170817
notes: Paper derives new 95% CL constraints on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma from multimessenger observations of NS merger GW170817 using Fermi-LAT data. The main exclusion is shown in Fig. 4 in the (m_a, g_agamma) plane spanning roughly m_a ~ 0.01-1000 MeV and g_agamma ~ 1e-12 to 1e-7 GeV^-1. However, the actual exclusion contour values are only available in a figure that is not numerically tabulated in the text. The only explicit numerical (mass, coupling) pairs given are the two benchmark points (Benchmark 1: m_a=398 MeV, g=5.01e-11 GeV^-1; Benchmark 2: m_a=200 MeV, g=1.41e-12 GeV^-1), which lie in unconstrained parameter space (not on the exclusion boundary). These benchmarks are reported here as the only extractable numeric points but do NOT represent the exclusion limit boundary.
